Step 1: Load the packages and gene names
```{r}
#Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

geneNames <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")
head(geneNames)

# Load covariate and gene expresion data
covar <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
geneExpression <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv") |>
  column_to_rownames("X")

dim(covar)
dim(geneExpression)

```

Step 2: Select three genes for analysis
```{r}
# Select SSTR3, CNR1, and NFYC
selecgenes <- c("SSTR3", "CNR1", "NFYC")
# Find the probe IDs for our selected genes
geneNames %>%
  filter(GENE %in% selecgenes)
```

Step 3: Cleaning and matching our data for the 3 genes
```{r}
# Match gene expression values for our three genes
for (gene in selecgenes) {
  geneID <- as.character(geneNames[
    geneNames$GENE == gene, "PROBEID"
  ])
  covar[,gene] <- as.numeric(geneExpression[geneID, covar$geoID])
}
View(geneExpression) 




```
